description: Search saved Brain memories. A memory may be a singular fact or a short Markdown mini-doc. Use a short, focused query with the key people, entities, preferences, or topics needed—not the full user message. Memories are retrieved with semantic + BM25 keyword search, reranked by a MiniLM cross-encoder, then expanded up to two hops along related_to graph links so connected memories surface with the seeds. Each memory includes addedBy (who first saved it) and versionCount (saved revisions). When versionCount is greater than 1, call get_memory_versions for the full history. Call get_memory whenever a result has truncated: true so you read the full note, not a clipped preview. Always pass brain from list_brains.

brain.description: Brain id from list_brains. The personal brain is "personal".

entityType.description: Optionally restrict results to one memory entity type.

kind.description: Optionally restrict results to work or profile memories.

limit.description: Maximum memories to return (1-64). Score-gated, then padded to at least 10 when candidates exist.

query.description: Focused query for the saved facts needed.

name: search_brain
title: Search brain
